''See also: [[Hallow Divide Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Hallow [[Divide]] is a powerful entity that manifests as a broad, shimmering silver [[sword]] with a straight blade. [[Forged]] from one piece of metal, he possesses the ability to hover point-down and can project multiple versions of himself simultaneously. Historically, Hallow [[Divide]] has been responsible for the burial of [[World Spirits]]. In combat, he functions as a [[Zenith Blade]] that can carry a user's [[Combat Art]], create defensive structures like cages of energy, or strike with great force to destroy weapons and deplete an opponent's mass reserves. Despite his destructive capabilities, he expresses a preference for not killing honorable Combat Artist{{!}}Combat Artists and suggests settling disputes through specific ritualistic meetings rather than standard battlefield combat. He is distinct from [[Aethertech]] weaponry in that he does not cause soul-burning or unhealable wounds to his wielder.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Initially identified as a defensive [[Combat Art]] used by [[Omega’s daughter]], Hallow [[Divide]] is a weapon held by [[Aila Escalon]] that projects circular shields. This [[Zenith Device]], also known as the [[Zenith Blade]], has a history of burying [[World Spirits]] and exists alongside other copies that have since disappeared. The entity manifests as a character projecting an orange digital face, declaring that strong [[Aether]] benefits the health of the galaxy and potentially possessing the power to sever contracts. As a devastating [[Combat Art]], it may be able to sustain other techniques and was used by [[Aila Escalon]] to stop an attack from Queen Shyrax{{!}}Shyrax by creating a cage of orange slashes. Beyond its use as a [[technique]], Hallow [[Divide]] also serves as the territory where the champions of [[Horizon]] engage in combat.}}
